## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally

## Source policy (required if this touches adapters, downloads, manifests or keys)

- [ ] Not applicable
- [ ] Read-only discovery: only reads local launcher metadata, modifies nothing
- [ ] New or changed download source. Authorisation basis (rights holder / licensed distributor / redistributable licence):
      Evidence and register row added to `docs/SOURCE_POLICY.md`:
- [ ] No torrent, magnet or peer-to-peer transport added
- [ ] No executable patching, DRM or entitlement circumvention
- [ ] No partner names or logos without written permission
